meta.description: Column (long) multiplication practice for the column_operation widget. Year 4 = 3-digit and 4-digit multiplicands by a single digit; Year 5 = 3-digit by 2-digit with partial-product rows. No multiplier is 1. Answers are computed by the app from operands/operator, so every 'answers' list is empty. Each group carries the keys for both import doors - see group() in the generator.
